item.description: The number of moose in Minnesota is about half what it was just 20 years ago.

item.description: President Trump has warned that failure to reach an agreement could result in military action against Iran.

item.description: There are a few phrases, quotations, that get used over and over in different contexts.

item.title: Foxborough board won't issue World Cup licenses until security costs are covered
item.description: As Foxborough prepares for FIFA World Cup games at Gillette Stadium this summer, town officials want to know who's paying for safety and security. At a public meeting Tuesday select board members expressed frustration at a lack of answers from FIFA and the Boston organizing committee. On Wednesday, Gov. Maura Healey said she's "confident that things will work out."

item.title: Remembering a legendary documentarian whose film was so controversial, it was banned
item.description: Frederick Wiseman died Monday at age 96. The prolific, Boston-born filmmaker made roughly 50 documentaries. His most famous film was a look inside a Massachusetts correctional facility for those with mental illness.

item.title: Jesse Jackson and the arc of Black hope
item.description: Jesse Jackson widened what "possible" meant, writes Imari K. Paris Jeffries. "He proved that a Black presidential candidacy could be a serious campaign that competed across regions and issues. That changed the country's political muscle memory, and it changed the expectations of the next generation."

item.title: Authorities are using deep-sea tech to try find the sunken fishing boat off Gloucester
item.description: A coalition of authorities is deploying technology to try to locate the wreck of a fishing boat that sank last month off Massachusetts, killing all seven aboard. But winter weather and sea conditions have thus far slowed their efforts.

item.title: Inside PragerU’s conservative push into American classrooms
item.description: PragerU is a conservative video giant. It’s produced more than 2,000 videos that it says promote American and Judeo-Christian values. Now its content is approved in 10 states’ school systems.

item.title: A year after tragedy, the Skating Club of Boston has something to cheer for at the Winter Olympics
item.description: Five members of the Skating Club of Boston died in a January 2025 plane crash. One year later, families and friends gathered to watch as fellow club skaters took to the ice at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan.
